description: This Java class 'EcuAddressImpl' implements the 'EcuAddress' interface and manages ECU address data, including construction, conversion to bytes, padding, and address list management within the RomRaider project.

classes.name: EcuAddressImpl
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates ECU address data, supports multiple constructors for different address inputs, provides methods for address retrieval and internal address processing.

methods.name: EcuAddressImpl(String, int, int)
methods.description: Constructor that creates addresses based on a single address string, length, and bit number.

methods.name: EcuAddressImpl(String[], int, int)
methods.description: Constructor that creates addresses from an array of address strings, length, and bit number.

methods.name: EcuAddressImpl(String[])
methods.description: Constructor that initializes with an array of addresses, with no specific bit.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the array of address strings managed by this object.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the address data as a byte array.

methods.name: getBit
methods.description: Returns the bit position associated with the address.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses managed.

methods.name: buildAddresses
methods.description: Generates a list of address strings based on input start address and required length, padding addresses as needed.

methods.name: padAddress
methods.description: Pads an address string with leading zeros to match the specified length.

methods.name: getAddressBytes
methods.description: Converts address strings into a concatenated byte array.
